## Breaking change

`ona_runner` `spec.desired_phase` is now **read-only**.

The Gitpod API rejects `desiredPhase` on `UpdateRunner` with `400 failed_precondition`:

> this API is deprecated - to disable local environments, please update your organization policy through the organization settings instead

Per the SDK, the field only ever applied to local-configuration runners, as an organization-wide toggle rather than a per-runner phase. Because `desired_phase` was `Optional + Computed`, state carried a concrete phase after create and the provider resent it on every update, so unrelated changes such as renaming a runner failed against remote runners.

### Upgrading

Remove `desired_phase` from any `ona_runner` configuration:

```diff
 resource "ona_runner" "example" {
   name          = "example"
   provider_type = "RUNNER_PROVIDER_AWS_EC2"

   spec = {
-    desired_phase = "RUNNER_PHASE_ACTIVE"
     configuration = {
       region = "us-west-2"
     }
   }
 }
```

Leaving it in place fails with `Value for unconfigurable attribute`. No state migration is needed: the attribute is still populated from the API, and `status.phase` continues to report the phase the runner is actually in. To control whether local runners are allowed, use the organization policy setting instead.
